description: Calculates the return on investment using compound interest formula. Returns the final amount and total return given an initial deposit, annual interest rate (as a percentage), and investment period in years. (cost: 1 credit)

initial_amount.description: number, required, initial deposit or principal amount in currency units

interest_rate.description: number, required, annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g., 5 for 5%)

num_years.description: number, required, investment period in years

name: calculate_investment_return
